# Silent media attribution

`nosleep-media.js` and `NoSleep-LICENSE.txt` were fetched unchanged from NoSleep.js v0.12.0:
https://github.com/richtr/NoSleep.js/tree/v0.12.0

The media data URIs and MIT notice are embedded in overlay.html so the cockpit works without internet access. The control and lifecycle code in the overlay is maintained locally. Native Screen Wake Lock is preferred when available. On the PS5 HTTP address, a user click starts the silent media fallback; actual screen-sleep prevention is browser/device dependent and must be checked on the physical Android device.
